item.title: Memory Loss
item.content:encoded:
An SCP that steals memories but doesn't keep them. They're stolen via the SCP looking into a target's eyes & can be stopped by one-way glass/similar stuff. Containment is mostly just the prevention of eye contact. The SCP is humanoid, looks like a young girl, has no memories of anything before containment & has trouble forming new memories (although it's not impossible, just takes repetitive exposure.)

But - at least in my opinion, it would be more interesting if the anomalous effects where a feature rather than a bug. If your gonna do a reality-warping thing, maybe the tablets cause reality to appear to warp in a way that makes people with the tablets to act in the interests of the project (e.g being unable to perceive or comprehend that the American government could do anything wrong). Perhaps the only reason why this failed was the creature appearing in every batch they made, and they can't explain it. But that's just spitballing.

I think you should stick to this idea, but, if you haven't, read some articles from series 6 and the how to write an SCP guide to get your bearings on what will be successful on the site.

Good Luck!

item.title: The Maw
item.content:encoded:
I understand that new authors typically don't write Keter-class scips, but this one just stuck with me, so here I am.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP article

Genre: Mysterious, desperate at times

Page Layout: Standard format (no ACS)

Elevator Pitch: A solar system that is roughly 2000 Au1 in diameter which is overtaken by a biomass of tremendous proportions. Said biomass is a colonial organism with organic linkages that span the distances between celestial bodies and envelop the planets themselves, effectively turning the entire system into a breeding ground for smaller units of the organism, thus furthering its reach. A central mass which measures ~1.92 million km in diameter engulfs the system's sun, and a large, ovular maw sits atop it.

+Brace Yourself
-You need more time to brace?

[This maw ejects chitinous pods (SCP-XXXX-2) containing small, wormlike entities measuring 45 cm in length (SCP-XXXX-2-A). These pods will crash within a 2 km radius of the coordinates 84"37'02"S 68"32'55"E (Antarctica). Approximately one (1) hour after landing, these worms will "hatch" and burrow into the ice. It is shown that organisms proceed to grow at an indeterminate rate while in these conditions.

When exposed to a human being, SCP-XXXX-2-A will merge with the human's spinal column, controlling synapses and effectively taking the subject over. These instances are aggressive to all forms of life and show resistance to pain. Due to this outcome, a mobile task force (Hammer Down, maybe?) will be stationed within this two kilometer zone, and the trajectories of SCP-XXXX-2 will be tracked. Upon finding the crash zone, MTF will destroy SCP-XXXX-2 and SCP-XXXX-2-A by several means (I've written up a list of these means that will be in the official article.)

The final section of this SCP (I promise), referred to as SCP-XXXX-3, is a triangular portal with equa-distant sides that measures 15 meters tall, located at 84"37'02"S 68"32'55"E. It transports anyone entering to a corresponding portal within SCP-XXXX-1 (the solar system).
]

SCP-XXXX-1 and SCP-XXXX-3 were destroyed by MTF during an exploration, thus re-classifying SCP-XXXX as neutralized.

Central Narrative: The article contains a few exploration logs, which culminates with an MTF force detonating a large device that cause the star to implode, eviscerating all components of the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Several, the first of which will be the title and the "Keter Neutralized" classification. An image too, if I can find one or make my own.

Footnotes
1. [The standard unit of measurement used to delineate extremely large distances]

item.title: A SCP idea I have
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): The standard SCP article format.

Elevator Pitch: The basic idea is a jointed 2 metre tall dummy made of hardwood. When someone views it, the person will begin to have visual hallucinations centered around the dummy, This usually drives the viewer to the point of insanity which almost always results in suicide. This is one of 2 methods of killing its victim. The alternative and less likely way of killing is directly attacking its victim, only moving when they are not looking.

Central Narrative: The entity was found inside of an abandoned factory with unknown origins, after many people complaining about seeing a "wooden thing" watching them from inside the factory. Paranormal investigators found this interesting and went inside, more than half of them were found dead in their own homes. Foundation researchers went on the case and successfully captures it, with the cost of more than half of the researchers found dead in their offices.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The article will be short and simple, it won't have too much information about the entity leaving a mystery, I am also hoping to add a feeling of dread.

Additional Notes: None.

item.title: What is Love?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama, History

Elevator Pitch: A demonic, non-corporeal entity formerly of divine origin that turned on humanity following a failed GOC neutralization attempt in the 1960s. The entity has limited control over the collective human psyche and has been worshipped by various ancient civilizations as a deity associated with love (Cupid/Eros, Bastet, Freyja, etc). After its fall, it began inflicting deleterious effects on the collective human unconsciousness most clearly observable in secular societies that could gradually lead to an IK-Class Collapse of Global Civilization Scenario if left unchecked. Symptoms include declining birth and marriage rates, increasing divorce and abortion rates, anxiety, low self-esteem, suicidal tendencies, and family breakdowns.

Central Narrative: A joint operation by the GOC, Foundation, and a handful of Serpent's Hand defectors led to the creation of the "Valentia Protocol", which trapped themselves and the entity in a stalemate. It's fueled by people's faith in love, which it actively works to destroy. If the Foundation does nothing it would destroy itself but with disastrous repercussions on the human psyche. By keeping it alive they can mitigate the risk to mankind but are likely only prolonging the inevitable. The primary goal is to buy enough time to find a permanent solution to its elaborate murder-suicide attempt.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The "Valentia Protocol" reveals that the proliferation and spread of Valentine's Day throughout the global community since the late 20th century is a Foundation psyop to counteract its effects. Despite displaying moderate success, this is only a temporary solution until the entity can be appeased, contained, or properly neutralized. Direct manipulation of the collective unconsciousness could have been utilized as a potential workaround if not for the obvious ethical implications as well as all research regarding this endeavor having been (allegedly) destroyed following the SCP-5000 incident.

item.title: My SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): I'm not exactly sure but it could fall under mystery I suppose.

Page Layout (Optional): Just a normal set up as this is my first article

Elevator Pitch: There are four parts to this SCPs

  1. A diamond ring in a small black box that when near you gives you weird dreams, all of the dreams have red plecos in them.
  2. A girl that is summoned when the diamond touches any object outside of the box. She will take on one trait from the item.
  3. An alternate universe where all of mankind has been wiped out.
  4. Large red plecos that are highly dangerous in the AU but laughably weak in the main universe.

Central Narrative: A man working for the Foundation would buy his girlfriend a ring in hopes of proposing to her. He would keep the ring with him for a few nights beforehand and would begin having weird dreams. After one of the dreams he would take out the ring and it would drop to his pillow. This would cause the girl to appear. He quickly reported this and the ring was taken and the girl was locked up. A few interviews were done but she was mostly too scared to speak, after 24 hours she disappeared. They would try to get her to come back and would find out that the ring has a cooldown of 12 hours. They would bring her back and interview her. They would find out that she was from a universe that was destroyed by beings she would call the "Blood Fish". They would ask her what these blood fish are and she would describe a common pleco but much larger and red. Later they would try to send a camera with her when she goes back to her universe. The camera would be destroyed and she would be sent back to the AU. Next time they would try to send a D-Class. The D-Class would begin to drain blood until all his blood has drained from his body and it is on the ground, killing him. Then one for the blood fish would appear, it would only be a foot long and would just start flopping in the blood. It would be placed in a fish tank where it would act like a normal fish. The girl would freak out during this before being teleported back. In later interviews, it would be shown that in the AU people began to use the blood of animals to replace water after a ton of large red fish began to appear in the rivers. No one seemed harmed by the blood until one day the fish began to float, then all but five people, who were able to resist the urge to consume blood, found five rings that would be able to fight off the fish. They failed and the fish killed all but one, the girl in this article. She was able to hide and due to the main universe's version of her ring being bought she was able to bond herself with that ring so that she can survive.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Unlike other AU SCPs this is one that does

Additional Notes: I can't think of any additional notes currently but I might add something here later if I think of anything.

item.title: Re: The Safe, Dark Deep
item.content:encoded:
Overall, I'm a big fan of the way the article and story is presented. I like the way the logs record the slow degradation of the mental state of the team, and the eventual total breakdown of order. While it's nothing too original, it contains a pretty interesting narrative and SCP.

+ Some Crit
- Hide Crit

SCP-XXXX holds two main anomalous properties.

This sentence and the use of "Firstly" and "Secondly" is a bit extraneous. I don't really see a need to state that their are two main anomalous properties when we are about to read them.

Hume readings in the area are incredibly low, indicating some force inside the cavern is altering reality. The side effects of this property make it so that conventional methods of terminating living organisms do not work (for reference please see Dr. Anna Lang’s research and SCP-3001).

SCP-3001 is my personal favorite, so I'm glad to see it being referenced here. However, one of the major effects of low hume levels as presented in that article is that they cause the disintegration of physical matter over time. This isn't too much of a problem, since the cave's regenerative factors likely make up for this, but it might needed to be directly stated in the article if that's the case.

There are a pretty large amount of grammatical errors in the description and some in the logs. I just suggest giving these another once-over for errors.

Also, having read the Idea thread, I personally prefer "The Abyss is Safe" for the title. It sounds a bit more original and eye catching to me.

item.title: The Wild Hunt
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mythology

Page Layout: towards the bottom of the full article, I plan on having a series of procedures for luring people indoors away from the storm with some discontinued due to not having the desired effect or being too impractical

Elevator Pitch: based around the core mythology of the Wild Hunt a group of knights lead by a king that appear during extremely powerful storms.
Amy male 12 years or older outside during the height of the storm fall under a kind of mind control, 'willingly' joining the Wild Hunt.

Central Narrative:

+ Show
- Hide

• disappearances across arctic and polar regions have been tracked, dating back years, connected to high power storms in said regions
• team is dispatched in front of high-powered storm, isolated from settlements (team receded incident in full)
• at height of storm the weather parts and an aroura borealis appears with Knights, Yeomen, Footmen and hounds seen running in the lights in the same direction as the storm is moving
• a king appeared and stopped above them, waving them to join
• In the forest below the king can be seen a glow and the team walk off towards it.
• the storm returns soon after with the team listed as MIA
• second test involved a D-class with eyewear to counter any magic effect on D-class
• same as before the Wild Hunt appears running along the aroura in the same direction of the storm.
• the king appears and states he is insulted a peasant would not bow before their king

item.title: LLUN Man Seeking Greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article, (Tale to come after article is put up)

Genre (Optional): Horror, Action, Scientific Study/Experimentation, (Cross-link required)

Page Layout (Optional): The page will start off with the basic article template, followed by a test log section. Sections will be minimized with expand buttons to save room.

Elevator Pitch:
James Devillian Twist is essentially a “Higher-Plane Monkey Wrench” working for the benefit of humanity as a self proclaimed “Vaccine”. He is an invasive source of hidden knowledge of which he is incapable of passing onto others. Twist is surrounded in what he calls a “LLUN” aura, which causes Twist’s hume levels to be relatively low compared to his surroundings and prevents communication of certain facts from him to sentient beings. It also causes him to be almost completely undetectable to higher-plane beings. The only way a higher-plane being can know of Twist’s existence is if they are within Twist’s line of sight. The aura will protect Twist from any mind reading or reality warping attempt on his person. If information is somehow drained from Twist via any method, the LLUN curse will spread to wherever the information reaches without discrimination. Further information will be gone over in the article.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative:
Much of what is about to be mentioned will be subtly and meticulously revealed over the course of the article and subsequent tales. James Devillian Twist is an intruder in the version of reality that he is introduced in. He is considered to be a divine monkey wrench or someone who can and will ruin the plans of higher-plane beings for the sake of humanity’s future. There was and is no seeing him coming. Precognition will never be able to catch a glimpse of him or his machinations. He was and is a random shot in the dark, originating from an unknown realm with unknowable ties to the chaos realm of LLUN, an ever-encroaching realm that surrounds all dimensions within the multiverse. Having been forcefully injected into this reality from outside its space-time continuum, Devillian has successfully altered the course of events leading to whatever future was previously preordained. By his mere existence, however temporary it may be, destiny’s hand has been stabbed by this reality that Devillian has been forced into.

Twist, upon looking at a target, will instantly know what makes that target tick. He will know what they are made of, what made them the way they are, and what motivates their actions, words, and movements. Further information will be disseminated via the article and tales.
A key, integral part of this SCP article lies in the interviews and experimentations that take place on him. The story is about discovery and how much information can actually be obtained with the obstacle of the LLUN aura in the way.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
Whenever someone is introduced to James Devillian Twist, it happens the same way every time. A man named Jack is running for his life in a big city, crying out for help. Upon someone reaching Jack and trying to calm him down, Jack will see Twist appear out of nowhere. Jack panics and flees. The person who would try to help Jack turns to see Devillian. What happens at that point differs from person to person. Some run at the mere sight of Devillian’s golden-bladed glove after seeing Jack panic the way he does. Others, unfortunate as they are, try to protect Jack and confront Twist. Needless to say, that never ends well for anyone. Regardless of what that person chooses to do, Devillian will continue onward until Jack has been successfully eliminated. Devillian will then vanish without a trace. After a random set period of time, Jack will reappear somewhere else and start running through a randomly chosen city, begging for help, and Devillian will appear soon after to kill him. Enter the SCP Foundation.
After trying and failing to save Jack from Twist, the SCP agents will be surprised to see that Devillian decides to willingly go with the SCP agents instead of vanishing into thin air. The real story begins from there.

Additional Notes:
I have a pretty good idea of what and how to make the article. However, this will be my very first SCP project attempt. I would very much like to know of any particular SCP stories that do anything similar so that I can make sure to further tweak my story into something more unique. I tried reading through some of the other SCP stories but there are just so many of them. Having someone point some out as a shortcut would be appreciated, though I do intend to read the others later on. My intention will be to have cross scp testing/experimentation with this SCP, not necessarily for anything combat related (though that will come up) but for information gathering purposes. I was also curious as to how difficult it would be to get in touch with other SCP authors for collaboration purposes.
